notes: §1985:XIV.3.1.2 prints 'ACCEPT cd-name-1 MESSAGE COUNT' with MESSAGE an optional word and COUNT a key word. The grammar's acceptMessageCountStatement is ACCEPT cobolWord messageKeyword? COUNT, dispatched by StatementBinder to CommunicationBinder#BindAcceptMessageCount, which resolves cd-name-1 through ResolveCommunicationCd (an input CD, COBOL6170 otherwise) and binds the MCS count; the facility is ungated at 85. Probes at --std 85 (class b refusal half and degenerate forms; class e the statement against an unknown queue and a configured one): ACCEPT CD-IN MESSAGE (the witness) COBOL5506 'expected COUNT', MESSAGE COUNT FROM CONSOLE and MESSAGE COUNT COUNT COBOL2269, ACCEPT MESSAGE COUNT with no cd-name COBOL0901, an output CD and a non-CD operand COBOL6170; ACCEPT CD-IN MESSAGE COUNT, ACCEPT CD-IN COUNT and the statement inside IF run, printing ST=20 CT=000000 with no queue QUEUEA defined and ST=00 CT=000003 with WISEOWL_COBOL_MCS naming an mcs.json whose QUEUEA holds three messages. Classes a, c, d, f do not apply.
